name: Modern Workwear
description: Heritage workwear pieces — chore coats, overshirts, canvas trousers — restyled with minimal modern basics instead of full head-to-toe vintage.
stylingRules: pair heritage outerwear with clean modern basics
keep footwear simple to modernize a vintage piece

name: Wide-Leg Tailored Trousers
description: A relaxed, high-rise wide-leg trouser replacing skinny fits as the default tailored bottom.
stylingRules: balance volume with a fitted top
hem to break just above the shoe

name: Chocolate Brown Tonal Dressing
description: Tonal brown dressing — several shades of brown worn together — as a warmer alternative to all-black.
stylingRules: dress head-to-toe in varying shades of the same brown

name: Quiet Luxury Basics
description: Unbranded, high-quality basics in a tonal neutral palette — logo-free dressing that reads expensive through fit and fabric alone.
stylingRules: invest in fabric quality over logos
keep palette tonal head to toe

name: Sheer Layering
description: Sheer mesh or chiffon tops layered over simple base layers rather than worn alone.
stylingRules: layer a sheer top over a fitted tank or bralette
keep the rest of the outfit simple so the layering reads intentional

name: Chunky Loafers
description: Lug-sole loafers replacing sleek dress shoes as the default smart-casual shoe.
stylingRules: cuff trousers slightly to show the sole

name: Western Boots
description: Pointed-toe western boots continuing to cross over from western wear into everyday styling.
stylingRules: wear with straight-leg denim so the toe is visible

name: Cargo Utility Pants
description: Multi-pocket utility cargos holding steady as a streetwear and gorpcore staple.
stylingRules: balance utility pockets with a slim top

name: Oversized Boyfriend Blazers
description: An intentionally oversized, borrowed-from-the-boyfriend blazer replacing the fitted power blazer.
stylingRules: roll the sleeves and cinch with a belt to add shape

name: Skate-Influenced Streetwear
description: Baggy, skate-shop-inspired fits — graphic tees, wide denim, flat skate shoes — back in daily streetwear rotation.
stylingRules: pair a graphic tee with baggy denim and skate shoes

name: Quiet Luxury Trench Coats
description: The classic belted trench holding steady as quiet luxury's defining outerwear piece.
stylingRules: belt rather than button for a more relaxed line

name: Gorpcore Layering
description: Technical outdoor gear — shells, fleece, trail shoes — styled for everyday city wear rather than the trail.
stylingRules: layer a technical shell over fleece with trail-inspired footwear

name: Corset-Inspired Tops
description: Structured corset-style tops worn over shirts as daywear rather than reserved for eveningwear.
stylingRules: wear over a shirt for a daytime take rather than as eveningwear only

name: Rugby Shirts
description: Striped, collared rugby shirts as a relaxed alternative to the polo.
stylingRules: wear untucked with tailored trousers to dress it up slightly

name: Longline Puffer Coats
description: Ankle- or knee-length puffer coats replacing the cropped puffer as winter's default statement outerwear.
stylingRules: belt at the waist to add shape to the volume

name: Cropped Cardigans
description: Cropped button-front cardigans layered over collared shirts or worn alone.
stylingRules: pair with high-waisted bottoms to keep proportions balanced

name: Barn Jackets
description: Canvas barn jackets carrying workwear's heritage appeal into everyday outerwear rotation.
stylingRules: layer over a hoodie or knit for a workwear-meets-casual look

name: Baggy Cargo Jeans
description: Baggy denim with cargo pockets combining the wide-leg and utility trends into one silhouette.
stylingRules: balance the volume with a slim or cropped top

name: Cherry Red Accent Color
description: A specific cherry-red shade used as the season's go-to accent color against neutral outfits.
stylingRules: use cherry red in one piece — bag, shoe, or coat — against neutrals

name: Quiet Luxury Cashmere Knits
description: Investment-grade cashmere knitwear in a relaxed, unfussy silhouette.
stylingRules: let the fabric be the only statement — keep everything else simple

name: Balletcore Flats
description: Ribbon-tied ballet flats carried over from balletcore into everyday rotation.
stylingRules: pair with cropped trousers to show the ribbon detail

name: Sculptural Sunglasses
description: Oversized, architectural sunglasses used as a standalone statement accessory.
stylingRules: let bold sunglasses be the outfit's single statement accessory

name: Y2K Low-Rise Revival
description: Low-rise denim returning from the early 2000s, generally styled with a longer top for balance.
stylingRules: balance a low-rise bottom with a longer top for coverage

name: Dopamine Color Palettes
description: Saturated, mood-boosting color used deliberately as an accent within an otherwise neutral outfit.
stylingRules: use one saturated color as an accent against neutral basics

name: Double Denim Styling
description: Head-to-toe denim styled with two contrasting washes to avoid looking like a matched set.
stylingRules: mix two different denim washes rather than matching exactly

name: Boho Maxi Skirts
description: Flowing, tiered maxi skirts in natural fabrics returning as a warm-weather staple.
stylingRules: pair with a fitted top to balance the volume

name: Mob Wife Maximalism
description: Glamorous maximalism — fur-look coats, gold jewelry, animal print — worn as a single statement layer over simple basics.
stylingRules: let one maximalist piece (fur coat, animal print) anchor an otherwise simple look

name: Pinstripe Tailoring
description: Pinstripe suiting fabric moved outside strict business tailoring into separates.
stylingRules: pair a pinstripe blazer with a solid-color base layer

name: Chore Coats
description: The simple four-pocket chore coat continuing as a minimalist workwear staple.
stylingRules: wear open over a plain tee for an easy workwear layer

name: Preppy Tennis Skirts
description: Pleated tennis-court skirts styled off the court with knitwear rather than athletic tops.
stylingRules: pair with a rugby shirt or fine-knit sweater off the court

name: Statement Belts
description: A wide belt with a statement buckle used to define the waist over oversized silhouettes.
stylingRules: cinch an oversized top or coat to define the waist

name: Ballet-Wrap Cardigans
description: A wrap-front cardigan tied at the waist, carried over from balletcore's rise.
stylingRules: tie at the waist rather than buttoning

name: Sporty Tech Fabrics
description: Performance technical fabrics crossing over from activewear into everyday tailoring.
stylingRules: mix one technical piece with a tailored piece to avoid looking purely athletic

name: Upcycled Denim Patchwork
description: Garments patchworked from reclaimed denim, worn as a visible sustainability statement.
stylingRules: let the patchwork piece stand alone against solid basics

name: Moto Leather Jackets
description: The asymmetric-zip moto jacket persisting as an outerwear staple across seasons.
stylingRules: layer over knitwear rather than a plain tee for texture contrast

name: Techwear Utility Vests
description: Multi-pocket technical vests layered over simple basics for a utilitarian streetwear look.
stylingRules: layer over a simple long-sleeve base

name: Argyle Knitwear
description: Diamond argyle knitwear returning as preppy dressing's signature pattern.
stylingRules: layer over a collared shirt, collar out

name: Statement Collars
description: An exaggerated, oversized collar worn over a sweater as a standalone statement detail.
stylingRules: let an oversized collar sit over a plain sweater or dress

name: Micro Shorts
description: Very short, high-rise shorts continuing the Y2K silhouette revival into warm-weather dressing.
stylingRules: balance with tall boots or a longer top

name: Grunge Revival Flannel
description: Oversized plaid flannel shirts returning from '90s grunge into streetwear layering.
stylingRules: tie around the waist or wear fully unbuttoned over a plain tee

name: Platform Loafers
description: A loafer built on a chunky platform sole, adding height and edge to a classic silhouette.
stylingRules: hem trousers to ankle length to show the platform

name: Micro Bags
description: Impractically small handbags carried as a pure styling accent rather than for storage.
stylingRules: treat as a styling accent, not for function

name: Ultra-Wide Denim
description: An exaggerated wide-leg denim silhouette pushing the wide-leg trend to its most extreme.
stylingRules: cuff or hem to avoid dragging, keep the top fitted

name: Coastal Grandma
description: Relaxed, breezy neutral linens and knits evoking an easy coastal off-duty wardrobe.
stylingRules: layer a linen shirt over a simple tank with wide trousers

name: Boxer Shorts Layering
description: Boxer-style shorts worn as a visible outer layer over tights or trousers rather than underneath.
stylingRules: layer boxer shorts over tights or trousers

name: Raw-Hem Denim
description: Denim finished with a raw, frayed hem instead of a clean cuff.
stylingRules: let the hem drag slightly and fray naturally rather than hemming clean

name: Fringe Trim Detailing
description: Suede fringe trim on jackets and bags as a western-adjacent detail.
stylingRules: let fringe be the only statement detail in the outfit

name: Lace Trim Layering
description: Delicate lace-trimmed camisoles worn peeking out from underneath open shirts.
stylingRules: let a lace camisole peek out from an unbuttoned shirt

name: Batik-Inspired Prints
description: Batik-inspired dyed prints appearing across resortwear and warm-weather separates.
stylingRules: pair a printed piece with solid neutral basics

name: Bandana Prints
description: Paisley bandana print returning as an accent print on scarves and accessories.
stylingRules: use as an accessory (neck scarf, headband) rather than a full print top
